**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Scan TSX files when adding web to traceability**

Adding `packages/web` here does not actually put most of the dashboard implementation under traceability: `buildCorpus` only reads `src` files ending in `.ts/.sql/.yml/.yaml` and test files ending in `.ts`, while these new web views/charts are `.tsx` and the design tokens are `.css`. In this AC-010-3/Recharts change, the verifier ignores `RechartsPanels.tsx` and the updated view components, so `mise run traceability` can pass based on an incomplete corpus instead of validating the dashboard code it is meant to cover.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
